host_note: Murayama (1925:229–230) originally described Crossotarsus quercivorus and reported three Japanese attacked-tree hosts. Schedl (1972:217) documents later Platypus usage, but the first transfer is unresolved. Schedl (1972:156) synonymized Crossotarsus sexfenestratus; source-specific taxonomic action verified.

taxonomic_history.name: Crossotarsus sexfenestratus
taxonomic_history.note: Schedl (1972:156) proposed a subjective synonym of P. quercivorus.
